title: Paper Board — Journals
description: paper-board/data/journals.json. Maps a journal/venue id to its details. Referenced by papers.json's journalId.

type.description: Drives the UI's venue color-coding. Workshops and proceedings series (LNCS, Procedia CS, EPJ Web of Conferences, ...) count as conference. arXiv/SSRN/Zenodo/Cryptology ePrint are preprint. USDOE/EuroHPC JU/European Commission/PRACE TR are report.
